16383828_3bd59255.text: New granule cells receive their first glutamatergic input on dendritic spines at the end of the second week after birth, and then project their first glutamatergic output onto area CA3 (Hagihara et al., 2011). The expression of glutamate receptors also shows temporal regulation, with granule cells beginning to profoundly express GluR1 at around 3 weeks after cell division (Hagihara et al., 2011).

16383828_d2ad6dc6.text: AMPA receptor subunits GluR1 and GluR2 are expressed in differentiated granule cells, but not in stem cells, in neonatal, and adult dentate gyrus
